_comment: Mutation testing, run by hand rather than in CI. Coverage says which lines ran; this says whether anything would notice if they were wrong. Scoped to the two pure layers everything else is built on. Run with `npm run mutation`. NOTE: NoCoverage here means no *unit* test -- the integration tier needs jsdom and cannot join this run; see vitest.mutation.config.ts.
_thresholdsComment: The floor is what the audit left the score at, less a point of slack: 80.5% combined when it was set, so `break` at 79. It is a ratchet against regression, not a target to climb. The mutants still alive are mostly unkillable -- the text inside an error message, the `?? []` behind a lookup that cannot miss -- and killing those would mean asserting on strings nobody reads. Raise the floor when real work raises the score; never lower it to make a run pass.
